pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with blurred, low-frequency edge gradients. Patches on the central flank exhibit larger spatial area compared to the smaller, more densely packed patches on the posterior haunch.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Thick, low-contrast negative space pathways. Junction nodes are primarily three-way intersections with diffuse boundaries between the light and dark pixels.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, dark vertical linear mark is visible on the mid-flank, cutting across two horizontal patch rows. This feature exhibits high contrast and sharp vertical edges compared to the surrounding pelage pattern.
